purpose: Show compact directional change while keeping movement separate from business sentiment.
useWhen: a metric has a truthful comparative direction
avoidWhen: a full chart is needed to explain a trend
the comparison direction or period is not supported by data
accessibility: Announces increased, decreased, or unchanged direction even when no explicit label is supplied.
Use label to explain domain meaning when direction and sentiment differ.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible or accessible name for the control.

visualization.intent: Show a compact directional comparison without encoding business sentiment implicitly.
consumerOwns: direction, value, comparison context, and sentiment meaning
ten4sevenOwns: text, icon, and non-color direction semantics

useWhen: consumer-calculated data needs a bounded visual comparison or trend
a concise chart plus a textual summary improves a decision surface
avoidWhen: a table or list is the clearer primary representation
business formulas, fetching, or export authorization would be hidden in the renderer
adaptiveStrategy: reduce ticks and wrap or move the legend below on narrow surfaces
use native press/selection callouts rather than hover
ai.accessibilityAlternative: Expose an accessible name and concise data summary; provide a list or table alternative when point-level access matters.
